title: Prenatal Development & Infancy
summary: Prenatal development: germinal, embryonic, fetal stages and teratogens. Infancy: physical, cognitive and social-emotional development in the first two years.
objectives: Describe infant development in physical, cognitive and social-emotional domains.
revision: Prenatal development (germinal, embryonic, fetal; teratogens) and infancy (physical, cognitive, social-emotional).
traps: Teratogen = environmental agent causing prenatal harm.

i: Germinal period: conception to 2 weeks — zygote formation and implantation
Embryonic period: 3 to 8 weeks — formation of major organs and body systems
Fetal period: 9 weeks to birth — growth and refinement of body systems

notes.t: An environmental agent (drug, virus, radiation) that can cause harm during prenatal development.

i: Physical: rapid growth, motor development (reflexes to voluntary movement)

notes.t: UGC NET frequently asks about prenatal periods, teratogens and infant development milestones.

mnemonics.title: GEFT
mnemonics.text: G — Germinal (0-2 weeks), E — Embryonic (3-8 weeks), F — Fetal (9 weeks-birth), T — Teratogen (harmful agent)
